title: argv and env

blocks.md:
## Flags the process already has

`process.argv` is the command line as a list of strings. Index `0` is the Node program. Index `1` is the script path. After that come the flags you typed. This lesson already runs with `--scrub` on that list.

`process.env` is a separate bag of names. `process.env.LAWP_FLAG` is set to `scrub` here. A missing name is `undefined`, not a fake heading.

Night desk: the fox walk log is only cleaned when `--scrub` is on the list. Print `scrub` if that flag is present.

blocks.promptMd: After `node` and the script path, `process.argv` holds your {{a}}. `process.env.LAWP_FLAG` is an {{b}} value.
